calibration_sampling: Stratified empirical bootstrap with replacement from TBX11K official training-split positive and negative score pools; prevalence is set by the grid.
evaluation_sampling: Independent stratified empirical bootstrap from the same class-conditional score pools; this is a simulation, not an external validation cohort.
head: logistic
interpretation_limit: This budget sweep characterizes a specified empirical bootstrap model. It does not establish performance, label quality, patient independence, or a PAC guarantee for a future clinical population.
split_unit: image-level empirical score bootstrap; patient linkage not verified
study: selective verification budget and prevalence bootstrap sweep
verification_policy: All scores at or above the source reference threshold are verified; lower-scoring cases are independently verified at the specified q.
